pages.title: About Voltage
pages.content:
Voltage started as a repair counter. For six years we fixed cracked screens, swollen batteries and water-logged earbuds, and we learned which gadgets were built to last and which were built to be replaced.

Today we sell the ones we would recommend to our own families: tested on our bench for a month before they reach the shelf, backed by a two-year warranty we honour ourselves, and supported by the same technicians who used to open them up.

How we choose

  • We open every product and check how repairable it is.
  • We run battery, heat and drop tests before listing anything.
  • We publish what we find, including the bits we did not like.
  • We keep spare parts for at least five years.

If we would not fix it, we will not sell it.

the Voltage bench

posts.title: How we test battery life
posts.excerpt: Brightness locked, the same playlist, the same scrolling robot: our rundown test, explained.
posts.content:
Battery claims on the box are measured in perfect conditions. Ours are not. Every phone and tablet we list goes through the same rundown test: screen locked at 200 nits, Wi-Fi on, a looping mix of video, browsing and a small robot finger that scrolls a social feed for ten minutes every hour.

We run the test three times, on the first charge, after a week and after a month, because batteries and software both settle in. The number we publish is the median, rounded down to the nearest half hour.

Charging speed gets the same treatment. We measure from 5% to 80% with the charger in the box, and with our own 65 W GaN charger, since that is what most of you will actually use.

The short version for the Nova X: two days of mixed use is real, and a twenty-minute top-up gets you through an evening.

posts.title: Choosing noise-cancelling headphones
posts.excerpt: Over-ear or in-ear, adaptive or fixed: what actually matters on a long flight.
posts.content:
Noise cancelling is best at steady, low sounds: engines, air conditioning, the rumble of a train. It is weaker against sudden, high sounds like voices, which is where a good passive seal does most of the work.

That is why fit matters more than any spec sheet. Over-ear cushions that seal around your ears block more chatter than earbuds, while earbuds win on size and on hot days. Try both if you can, and pick the one you will actually wear for five hours.

Adaptive cancelling adjusts to your surroundings in real time. It is worth it if you move between quiet offices and loud streets; for long flights, a fixed strong setting is just as good.

Finally, check comfort with glasses, battery with cancelling switched on and whether you can still use them wired when the battery runs out.

posts.title: A week with the Pulse smartwatch
posts.excerpt: Seven days, three runs, one forgotten charger: living with our favourite watch.
posts.content:
We gave the Pulse to the least gadget-minded person on the team and asked her to wear it for a week, including to bed. She forgot the charger at home on day one. It did not matter: the watch finished the week at 9%.

GPS locked within a few seconds on all three runs, and the distance matched a dedicated running watch to within a few metres. Heart rate tracked well on steady runs and lagged slightly on sprints, as wrist sensors tend to.

The sleep data was the surprise. The watch noticed two restless nights before she did, and the gentle wind-down reminder became a habit by Thursday.

Our only wish: a slightly brighter screen in direct summer sun. Otherwise, it is the watch we recommend to people who do not want to think about their watch.

products.name: Nova X Smartphone
products.description:
The Nova X is the phone we would give a friend. The 6.4-inch OLED display refreshes at up to 120 Hz and reaches 1,800 nits outdoors, the 5,000 mAh cell comfortably lasts two days, and the 50 MP main camera keeps detail in low light without the over-sharpened look.

It is built from a recycled aluminium frame and matte glass, charges to 60% in twenty minutes and is promised five years of system and security updates.

  • 6.4" OLED, 120 Hz, 1,800 nits peak
  • 50 MP main + 12 MP ultra-wide
  • 5,000 mAh, 45 W wired, 15 W wireless
  • IP68, dual SIM + eSIM
products.short_description: A 6.4" 120 Hz OLED phone with a two-day battery, a 50 MP camera and five years of updates.

reviews.author: Dario
reviews.content: Battery life is ridiculous. I charge it every other night and the screen is gorgeous outside.

reviews.author: Hana
reviews.content: Fast, clean software and a great camera. Silver picks up fewer fingerprints than I expected.

products.name: Pocket Tablet 8
products.description:
Small enough to read on the train with one hand, sharp enough for sketching and spreadsheets. The 8.3-inch laminated LCD has no air gap, so the stylus feels like it writes directly on the glass.

Quad speakers, USB-C with display output and eleven hours of video playback. Stylus sold separately.
products.short_description: An 8-inch tablet that fits a jacket pocket, with a laminated display and stylus support.

products.name: Studio ANC Headphones
products.description:
Forty-millimetre drivers tuned with a gentle, natural curve: clear vocals, controlled bass and no fatigue after a long flight. Adaptive noise cancelling listens to your surroundings and adjusts twice a second.

Memory-foam cushions, a fold-flat hinge and forty hours of battery with ANC on. A ten-minute charge gives four hours of playback.
products.short_description: Over-ear headphones with adaptive noise cancelling, 40 hours of playback and a fold-flat design.

reviews.author: Felix
reviews.content: Noise cancelling is on par with headphones twice the price, and they are light enough to forget you are wearing them.

reviews.author: Ana
reviews.content: Excellent sound. The case is a little bulky, but the battery life makes up for it.

products.name: True Wireless Earbuds
products.description:
Three ear-tip sizes and a contoured shape keep these in through runs and commutes. Hybrid noise cancelling takes the edge off traffic, transparency mode lets the world back in with a tap.

Eight hours per charge, thirty with the case, which charges wirelessly or over USB-C. IPX4 sweat resistance.
products.short_description: Compact earbuds with active noise cancelling, wireless charging and a secure, all-day fit.

products.name: Bookshelf Wi-Fi Speaker
products.description:
Two tweeters and a long-throw woofer in a cabinet the size of a hardback. Pair two for true stereo or group speakers across rooms over Wi-Fi.

Fabric front, walnut-finish sides and a line-in for your turntable.
products.short_description: A compact stereo speaker with Wi-Fi multiroom, Bluetooth and a warm, room-filling sound.

products.name: Pulse Smartwatch
products.description:
Pulse does the important things well: accurate GPS for runs and rides, continuous heart rate, sleep stages and a gentle nudge when you have been sitting too long. Notifications arrive quietly, replies are quick.

Choose a sport band for training, a woven band for every day or a steel link band for the office. Seven days of battery, five with the always-on display.
products.short_description: An always-on AMOLED watch with GPS, heart-rate and sleep tracking and a seven-day battery.

reviews.author: Tomasz
reviews.content: GPS locks in seconds and the battery really does last a week. The woven band is very comfortable.

products.name: Fitness Band 3
products.description: Everything you need, nothing you will not use: steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts on a bright little display. Waterproof to 50 metres and light enough to wear to bed.
products.short_description: A slim activity tracker with heart rate, sleep tracking and fourteen days of battery.

products.name: 65W GaN Fast Charger
products.description:
Gallium nitride lets us pack 65 watts into a charger the size of an egg. One USB-C port charges a laptop at full speed, or split the power between C and A ports for a phone and earbuds.

Folding pins and smart heat control.
products.short_description: A pocketable two-port charger that tops up a laptop and a phone at the same time.

products.name: Braided USB-C Cable
products.description: Double-braided nylon, reinforced strain reliefs and aluminium shells, tested to 30,000 bends. Long enough to reach from the floor socket to the sofa.
products.short_description: A 2 m braided USB-C cable rated for 100 W charging and 10 Gbps data.

products.name: Magnetic Power Bank
products.description: Snap it on, keep scrolling. The slim battery holds a full phone charge, has a fold-out kickstand and recharges over USB-C, or passes power through while it charges itself.
products.short_description: A 5,000 mAh magnetic battery that snaps to the back of your phone and charges wirelessly.

products.name: Low-Profile Mechanical Keyboard
products.description:
Low-profile tactile switches give a crisp, quiet bump without the height of a classic board. Connect up to three devices over Bluetooth or use the 2.4 GHz dongle for gaming, and swap switches without soldering.

Aluminium top plate, PBT keycaps and a battery that lasts weeks with the backlight off.
products.short_description: A compact 75% keyboard with hot-swap tactile switches, wireless and wired modes and white backlight.

reviews.author: Ruth
reviews.content: The typing feel is lovely and switching between my laptop and tablet is instant.

products.name: 4K Action Camera
products.description:
Stabilised 4K at sixty frames per second, horizon levelling up to 45 degrees and waterproofing to ten metres without a housing. Front and rear screens make framing easy.

This camera is sold and shipped by a partner store; the button takes you to their product page.
products.short_description: A waterproof 4K60 action camera with horizon levelling, sold and shipped by our partner.
